blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Filipino passenger bound for Vietnam was intercepted at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) Terminal 3 after being assessed as a “potential victim” of human trafficking or illegal recruitment, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said. According to the BI, the passenger attempted to board a flight on Nov. 7 after being recruited for a “purported job” with a foreign military that offered a “lucrative” employment package. BI officers flagged him over inconsistencies in his travel documents and statements.
